Abb Limited has informed the Exchange that the company has issued a global announcement of Global level with regards to its strategic vision and future goals. The Company has further informed that to support the execution of this strategy, the internal organization will also be adapted w.e.f. January 01, 2006. As part of this initiative, Mr. Ravi Uppal, Vice Chairman & Managing Director of ABB Limited (India) will also be responsible for the South Asia region, as Regional Head. At the same time, he will continue to retain his current position as Vice Chairman & Managing Director of ABB Limited (India). Mr. Dinesh Paliwal, Chairman of ABB Limited (India), will also take on the role of President, ABB Global Markets (including all geographical regions) and Group Technology. Further, the South Asia region will include India, Pakistan, Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Australia / New Zealand, Philipines and Vietnam. It may be noted that ABB operations in these countries, shall continue to function as independent entities.  Further, the Company has issued a Press Release dated September 09, 2005, titled "ABB sets out future vision and growth strategy; Organization realignment and regional approach to enhance synergy and value creation".
